title: Detect Gap in Order Identifier Sequence
description_markdown: Find all order IDs where `(order_id + 1)` does NOT exist in `orders`, identifying a gap in the sequence. Exclude the maximum `order_id` in the table. Return `order_id AS gap_start_id`, `(order_id + 1) AS missing_id`. Order by `gap_start_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Identify sequence gap
SELECT order_id AS gap_start_id, (order_id + 1) AS missing_id
FROM orders o
WHERE NOT EXISTS ...
solution_query: SELECT o.order_id AS gap_start_id, (o.order_id + 1) AS missing_id FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.order_id = o.order_id + 1) AND o.order_id < (SELECT MAX(order_id) FROM orders) ORDER BY gap_start_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Standard anti-semi-join gap detector that flags missing sequential integers.
